question: Does combined HEAD01+BODY01 show meaningful net source-alignment progress over immutable09, and which modules should remain in the next integration?
decision_scope: Retention of BOTH modules or accepted net integrated gain; useful early development evidence may be preserved without accepting either replacement. Not target completion.

claims.finding: Exact saved09 source/native pins and matched baseline/candidate camera/light settings corroborated by bytes, receipt equality, producer code and direct actual image dimensions. Rendering itself not independently replayed.

Independent original/baseline/candidate readbacks show no differences in checked original receiving coordinates/topology/UV/face assignments/slots/attributes/groups/transforms/parents/modifier parameters, material-node graph fields and FILE packed bytes/metadata.69 visibility retirements match declaration;58 new meshes (22head,36body). Counts alone were not the proof.
Local breast construction gain is visible, but the current combined front/head coverage and optic readability regression leave meaningful net whole-character source gain unsettled.
Both modules cannot be retained on their individual merits from the combined view. Worker regional side/rear/head images are separate authoring contexts, not matched integrated ablations.
Advanced-only early study cannot establish complete three-era visual twin, final source alignment, browser outcome or owner artistic acceptance.

Source still has more varied narrow formed-metal construction. Technical custody does not resolve that net visual tradeoff.

body01.confidence: moderate for a useful local construction direction; provisional for integrated retention
body01.finding: Short rounded breast overlap gives a visible local alternative to elongated smooth courses; whole-side shape and source variety still imperfect.

head01.finding: Segmented plates change the head, but the dominant broad brow/bill sheets and more obscured normal-scale optic require a matched integrated comparison to decide the tradeoff.

smallest_decisive_next_check.action: Produce one new BODY01-only ablation at the exact current saved09 whole neutral camera/light,640x426 and4samples, both clay and PBR. Compare that image with the frozen baseline and combined candidate at identical display scale. This isolates whether adding HEAD01 helps or harms the useful body direction.
smallest_decisive_next_check.boundary: New output ID outside this freeze; no rerender overwrite. This review does not authorize broader modeling, pose change or publication.
smallest_decisive_next_check.what_falsifies_objection: If combined candidate clearly improves source-specific head construction/optic reading over BODY01-only without losing whole-bird gain, the head objection can be rejected. Otherwise retain body direction provisionally and reopen head construction.
